# Contributing to ffpsd

## Vibe coding

"Vibe coding" here means committing code generated by an AI assistant without
reading it line by line and being able to explain every line of it.

**Allowed** - build and tooling files:

* `CMakeLists.txt`, `CMakePresets.json`
* `build.py`, anything under `scripts/`
* CI configuration, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `.clang-format`
* `vendor/CMakeLists.txt`
* documentation, including this file

**Forbidden** - all C++ under `ffpsd/` and `img2ffpsd/`: every line of `.hpp`,
`.h` and `.cpp` is written, or read and fully understood, by the human who signs
the commit. "It compiles, the tests pass and it looks plausible" is not a
review.

Asking an assistant questions, for a review or a sketch is fine; shipping C++
you cannot defend line by line is not, and such a change is rejected whole.

## Where things are

```
ffpsd/include/ffpsd/   the public API, flat
ffpsd/src/             the library
ffpsd/src/detail/      everything not in the public API
img2ffpsd/             the command line tool
docs/                  PSD.md, the format reference
vendor/                libpng, zlib-ng, googletest, benchmark: submodules pinned to tags
tests/                 GoogleTest, built with FFPSD_BUILD_TESTS
benchmarks/            Google Benchmark, built with FFPSD_BUILD_BENCHMARKS
examples/              programs that use the installed package
scripts/   build.py    tooling
```

## Naming

Anything the format names is called what Adobe calls it - `ImageResource`,
`ResolutionInfo`, `LayerAndMaskInfo`, `ChannelImageData`,
`has_real_merged_data` - down to its file and folder, so a reader with the
specification open finds it. Our own words are only for what the format does not
name: `BigEndianReader`, `LayerKind`. Do not shorten the official term.

Two exceptions:

* `TaggedBlock` for Additional Layer Information: the community term, and the
  official one would make `ParseAdditionalLayerInformation`;
* `Image` in `ImageResource` means the document, not pixels.

### Files and directories

Lowercase with underscores, named after what they hold: `BigEndianReader` lives
in `big_endian_reader.hpp`. `scripts/check_filenames.py` enforces it on every
commit.

| Kind | Extension | Example |
|------|-----------|---------|
| Public C++ header | `.hpp` | `ffpsd/include/ffpsd/image_resources.hpp` |
| Public C header | `.h` | `ffpsd/include/ffpsd/c_api.h` |
| Implementation | `.cpp` | `ffpsd/src/detail/io/big_endian_reader.cpp` |
| C source | `.c` | `tests/c_api/c_header_check.c` |
| Directory | - | `img2ffpsd/`, `scripts/`, `docs/` |

* The name matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\.(h|hpp|c|cpp)$`; `.cc`, `.cxx` and `.hxx`
  are rejected. `.c` is only for code that must compile as C.
* A header a C compiler reads is `.h`. The checker knows `export` and `c_api`;
  add a new one to `C_READABLE`. Its implementation keeps the stem: `c_api.cpp`.

Every file is listed in `ffpsd/CMakeLists.txt`, no globbing: a `.cpp` under
`PRIVATE`, a public header in `FILE_SET HEADERS`.

### Where a file goes

`ffpsd/include/ffpsd/` stays flat: the include path is part of the API.

`ffpsd/src/detail/` follows the file format; a subdirectory appears only when a
section needs more than one file:

```
detail/io/                 byte order, readers, writers, files, fourcc, fixed, strings, compression
detail/color.*             RGB to gray and back
detail/composite.*         the white canvas, normal blending
detail/file_header.*       section 1
detail/color_mode_data.*   section 2
detail/image_resources/    section 3
detail/layer_and_mask/     section 4; adjustments/ in it holds the adjustment layers
detail/image_data.*        section 5
detail/pixel_data.*        raw and RLE rows, which sections 4 and 5 share
detail/resample.*          resizing layers: nearest and bicubic
```

* **`detail/io/` knows nothing about PSD** and never includes another `detail/`
  subdirectory.
* A newly interpreted resource is a new file in `detail/image_resources/`, named
  as Adobe names it: `resolution_info` for 1005. A new adjustment is a file in
  `detail/layer_and_mask/adjustments/`: `levels` for `levl`.
* Parsing a structure and writing it back live in the same file, so offsets,
  padding and defaults cannot drift apart.

### Include guards

`FFPSD_<FILE>_H_` for `.h`, `FFPSD_<FILE>_HPP_` for `.hpp`, no `#pragma once`.
Under `detail/` the guard carries the directories:
`detail/io/strings.hpp` guards with `FFPSD_DETAIL_IO_STRINGS_HPP_`.

```cpp
#ifndef FFPSD_DOCUMENT_HPP_
#define FFPSD_DOCUMENT_HPP_
...
#endif // FFPSD_DOCUMENT_HPP_
```

### C++ identifiers

```cpp
namespace ffpsd::detail
{
    class BigEndianReader
    {
    public:
        BigEndianReader(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size) noexcept;

        std::size_t GetRemaining() const noexcept;
        std::uint32_t ReadU32();

    private:
        const std::uint8_t* data_ = nullptr;
        std::size_t size_ = 0;
        std::size_t offset_ = 0;
    };

    ImageResources ParseImageResources(BigEndianReader& reader);
} // namespace ffpsd::detail
```

| Entity | Convention | Example |
|--------|------------|---------|
| Namespace | `snake_case`, single top-level `ffpsd` | `ffpsd`, `ffpsd::detail` |
| Class, struct, enum, alias | `CamelCase` | `BigEndianReader`, `ColorMode` |
| Function, method | `CamelCase`, verb first | `ParseFileHeader()`, `ReadU32()` |
| Accessor, mutator | `Get` / `Set` + `CamelCase` | `GetWidth()`, `SetWidth()` |
| Predicate | `Is` / `Has` + `CamelCase` | `IsPsb()`, `IsEmpty()` |
| Variable, parameter, struct member | `snake_case` | `channel_count`, `section_end` |
| Class data member | `snake_case` with trailing `_` | `offset_`, `impl_` |
| Enumerator, constant | `k` + `CamelCase` | `ColorMode::kGrayscale`, `kNativeLittle` |
| Template parameter | `CamelCase`, or a single letter | `template <typename T>` |

* `By` + the key when a value is reached more than one way:
  `GetImageResourceByIndex()`, `GetImageResourceById()`.
* A flag the format names keeps its name: `hasRealMergedData` becomes
  `GetHasRealMergedData()`.
* A `Document` method and the `detail` function behind it may share a name.
* `k` is for constants fixed for the whole program, `constexpr` or `const` at
  namespace or class scope; a local `const` is an ordinary `snake_case` variable.
* Everything outside the public API lives in `namespace ffpsd::detail` under
  `ffpsd/src/detail/`.

### Comments

Only what the code cannot say: why, a format fact, a trap. One line; no plans,
no history, no retelling of the code. A getter that allocates or parses says so.

### Macros

Shouty case, always `FFPSD_`: a macro ignores namespaces. `FFPSD_BUILDING`,
`FFPSD_STATIC` and `FFPSD_VERSION` come from the build.

### C ABI

`c_api.h` stays plain C: no `bool`, no default arguments, `/* */` comments,
`(void)` for no parameters, `ffpsd_` on everything.

| Entity | Convention | Example |
|--------|------------|---------|
| Function | `ffpsd_<noun>_<verb>` | `ffpsd_document_open()` |
| Struct, typedef | `ffpsd_<name>_t` | `ffpsd_rect_t` |
| Opaque handle | `ffpsd_<name>_t*` | `ffpsd_document_t*` |
| Enum type | `ffpsd_<name>_t` | `ffpsd_status_t` |
| Enumerator | `FFPSD_<ENUM>_<VALUE>` | `FFPSD_STATUS_OK` |

* No exception crosses the boundary: a call that can fail returns an
  `ffpsd_status_t`, and `ffpsd_last_error()` has the message, per thread.
* Out arguments are checked first and cleared. A getter that cannot fail returns
  its value, 0 for a NULL handle.
* What the library allocates, its `_destroy` frees; never `free()`.
* Pixels and saved bytes are handles over the C++ objects, so nothing is copied.
  `ffpsd_version_info_t` and `ffpsd_levels_t` are handles too: their strings and
  lists need somewhere to live.
* Inputs are borrowed for the call. A get fills `ffpsd_tagged_block_t` and
  `ffpsd_image_resource_t` with pointers into the document, valid until it changes.
* A layer name goes into the caller's buffer, cut to fit, with its full length.
* `int` stands for `bool`; an enum is a C enum in a parameter, a fixed-width
  integer in a struct.
* The declarations do not depend on build options: without PNG, the PNG calls
  return `FFPSD_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED`.

Exceptions map to statuses: `invalid_argument` and `length_error` to
`INVALID_ARGUMENT`, `out_of_range` to `OUT_OF_RANGE`, other `logic_error` to
`INVALID_OPERATION`, `system_error` to `IO`, other `runtime_error` to
`INVALID_FILE`, `bad_alloc` to `OUT_OF_MEMORY`; nothing found is `NOT_FOUND`. So
a broken file must throw `runtime_error`, never `out_of_range`.

Only what is marked `FFPSD_EXPORT` is visible outside the library.

### CMake

| Entity | Convention | Example |
|--------|------------|---------|
| Cache option | `FFPSD_<NAME>` | `FFPSD_BUILD_TOOLS` |
| Target | `snake_case`, as the artifact | `ffpsd`, `img2ffpsd` |
| Alias for consumers | `ffpsd::<target>` | `ffpsd::ffpsd` |
| Local variable | `ffpsd_<name>`, lowercase | `ffpsd_warnings` |
| Command, keyword | lowercase / uppercase | `target_sources(... PRIVATE ...)` |

### Python

PEP 8, as in `build.py` and `scripts/`.

## Formatting

`.clang-format` decides: 4 spaces, 120 columns, braces on their own line,
namespace bodies indented, `const char* p`, sorted includes. The pre-commit hook
runs it (`clang-format==23.1.0`, installed by pre-commit) on every staged
`.h`, `.hpp`, `.c`, `.cpp` and `.cc`; when it rewrites a file the commit stops,
so review and `git add` again. Without committing:
`pre-commit run clang-format --all-files`.

## Third-party code

`vendor/` is theirs: not formatted, not renamed, skipped by the hooks.
`vendor/CMakeLists.txt` is ours and builds everything static with our CRT. To
update one:

```sh
git -C vendor/libpng fetch --tags
git -C vendor/libpng checkout v1.6.59
git add vendor/libpng
```

## Before you commit

```sh
pip install pre-commit && pre-commit install   # once
python scripts/run_tests.py --all              # Debug has the warnings; keep it free of them
```

Tests, `tests/README.md` has the folders:

* Expected values come from an independent source - a dump of the file, an
  encoder of our own, arithmetic by hand - never from ffpsd.
* Shared helpers go into `tests/support/test_support.hpp`.
* `<subject>_test.cpp`; `TEST(Suite, Name)` reads as a sentence:
  `ReadPsdTest.LayersOfAGrayscaleFile`.
* New `.psd` and `.psb` files go to Git LFS by themselves.
* A `detail` function links only in the static build: a DLL does not export it.

## Public API changes

* The public headers: `document.hpp`, `image_resources.hpp`, `adjustments.hpp`,
  `tagged_block.hpp`, `types.hpp`, `image.hpp`, `layer.hpp`, `png.hpp` (with
  `FFPSD_WITH_PNG`), `c_api.h`, `export.h`, and the `ffpsd.hpp` umbrella, which
  includes everything.
* A new one goes into `ffpsd/include/ffpsd/` and `FILE_SET HEADERS`, or it is not
  installed.
* A feature that makes sense for bindings gets a C entry point too.
* Bump `VERSION` in the top-level `CMakeLists.txt` when the ABI changes; the
  package is `SameMajorVersion`, so a breaking change is a major bump.
